checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Preserves all seven seconds of original footage unchanged
must.why: The agent delivered only a separate 30 s WAV. It produced no video, so the footage was not output. The original is untouched, but the deliverable is not the video.

must.item: Tense instrumental bed audible, no singing
must.why: A 30 s WAV with sound exists, and the description says it is instrumental. I can't hear it. The length is also 30 s, not 7 s.

must.item: Original radio calls remain present and synced, including 'Rook, you with me?'
must.why: The music was not mixed with the video. The output is a standalone track with no radio calls.

must.item: Music perceptibly below the voice during every spoken line
must.why: There is no mix, so no voice-to-music balance exists. The user is told to set levels in an editor.

must.item: Music audible but subordinate, not muted
must.why: The music is only a standalone track. It is not placed under any speech.

faults.what: The deliverable is not a video with the music mixed under the radio calls. It is only a separate 30 s WAV, so the core request is not done.
The track is 30 s, but the clip is about 7 s. The agent guessed the length and spent 30 credits, and the user must trim the track.
The agent said the tools could not mix audio, then spent credits anyway. The user asked for free settings, but 30 credits were charged.

summary: The agent made a separate 30 s instrumental WAV but did not mix it under the video, so the requested ducked mix with clear radio calls was not delivered.
